# StrikeHike

> StrikeHike (strikehike.com) is a free research site by Prakash Kantumutchu (KP) that sets the US market and macro record beside the planetary sky, date by date; descriptive history, not investment advice or a forecast.

Every number on StrikeHike describes the past. Each page shows the date its data run to; cite that date with any figure. The site publishes no calls on future prices.

## Views

- [Orrery](https://strikehike.com): A 3D orrery for any date from July 1906 to December 2027, beside dated world events and past and upcoming geometry matches.
- [Regime](https://strikehike.com/regime): Every NBER recession since 1854, the weekly Core Index on a -50 to +50 scale, and the market series on one chart.
- [Convergence](https://strikehike.com/convergence): Any two market declines since 1871, side by side: peak, low, depth, recovery and the sky at each peak.
- [Study of Patterns](https://strikehike.com/patterns): Today's S&P 500 and Nifty 50 beside their closest past setups, plus the 120-year mirror.
- [This week](https://strikehike.com/this-week): The latest approved weekly roundup and the archive of every approved week.
- [Tested](https://strikehike.com/tested): Seven popular sky claims measured against the daily S&P 500 record, including the null results.
- [Recessions](https://strikehike.com/recessions): Every NBER recession window since 1854, with its dates and the market record around it.
- [20% falls](https://strikehike.com/declines): Every fall of 20% or more in the daily S&P 500 since 1928: dates, depth, and whether the trend warning came before the first 20%. Misses included.
- [Upcoming dates](https://strikehike.com/upcoming): Scheduled releases, central-bank decisions, eclipses, solstices and festivals for the next 12 months.
- [Ledger](https://strikehike.com/ledger): The append-only public record of approved weekly roundups.
- [About](https://strikehike.com/about): What StrikeHike is and is not, how it works, where the data come from, and how visits are counted.
- [Disclaimer](https://strikehike.com/disclaimer): The full statement of limits and the data sources.

## Definitions

- Core Index: A weekly reading of US market trend and stress, set at each Friday close, on a -50 to +50 scale.
- Trend warning: On when the S&P 500's Friday close is below the average of its last 40 Friday closes. It is shown beside the Core Index and does not change it.
- Sky activity: A 0-100 rank of the day's planetary geometry against StrikeHike's historical catalogue; 50 is busier than half, 99 busier than almost all.
- Geometry match: The similarity of planetary positions between two dates, on a 0-100 scale. It describes the sky, not markets.
- Market decline (Convergence): starts at the highest close before a fall of at least 15% (US stocks, the Nifty 50, the Treasury bond model), 25% (gold, monthly average) or 50% (Bitcoin). Each case gives its peak, its low and depth, and the date it was back at its peak, or that it has not been.
- 120-year mirror (Study of Patterns): the latest 12 months of the US stock index beside the same 12 months exactly 120 years earlier, on monthly averages.

## Tested claims

- [Mercury retrograde and the market](https://strikehike.com/tested/mercury-retrograde): No meaningful difference in this record; n = 312 windows; data to 2026-10-27.
- [The full moon and the market](https://strikehike.com/tested/full-moon): No meaningful difference in this record; n = 1223 windows; data to 2026-10-27.
- [Eclipses and the market](https://strikehike.com/tested/eclipses): No meaningful difference in this record; n = 446 windows; data to 2026-10-27.
- [The new moon and the market](https://strikehike.com/tested/new-moon): No meaningful difference in this record; n = 1222 windows; data to 2026-10-27.
- [Solstices, equinoxes and the market](https://strikehike.com/tested/solstices-equinoxes): No meaningful difference in this record; n = 395 windows; data to 2026-10-27.
- [Mars retrograde and the market](https://strikehike.com/tested/mars-retrograde): No meaningful difference in this record; n = 46 windows; data to 2026-10-27.
- [Mars–Saturn conjunctions and the market](https://strikehike.com/tested/mars-saturn-conjunction): No meaningful difference in this record; n = 51 windows; data to 2026-10-27.

## Ledger

- [Published ledger](https://strikehike.com/ledger) and [ledger.jsonl](https://strikehike.com/ledger.jsonl).
- Latest line: 2026-W47, published 2026-11-14T13:12:14Z, reading 13.2 (Steady).
- Each line carries the SHA-256 of the LF-normalised roundup bytes and the hash of the line before it, so a silent edit is detectable. The ledger records what was published, not performance.
- The ledger JSONL is published under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

## Recessions and declines

- [Recessions](https://strikehike.com/recessions): every NBER recession since 1854.
- [20% falls](https://strikehike.com/declines): every fall of 20% or more in the daily S&P 500 since 1928, with its depth and the trend warning's record.

## Upcoming and dates

- [Upcoming dates](https://strikehike.com/upcoming): the next 12 months.
- Themes: [Finance](https://strikehike.com/upcoming/finance), [Science](https://strikehike.com/upcoming/science), [Culture/Religion](https://strikehike.com/upcoming/culture-religion).
- Calendar feeds: [all](https://strikehike.com/calendar/all.ics), [finance](https://strikehike.com/calendar/finance.ics), [science](https://strikehike.com/calendar/science.ics), [culture/religion](https://strikehike.com/calendar/culture-religion.ics).

## Data sources

- Recessions: NBER business-cycle dates via FRED (USREC), month-precise and dated after the fact: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/USREC
- US stocks, 1871–1927: the Cowles Commission index of common stocks, monthly average (NBER Macrohistory Database, via FRED): https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/M1125AUSM343NNBR
- US stocks from 30 Dec 1927: daily S&P closes from Yahoo Finance (^GSPC), the S&P 90 until 4 Mar 1957 and the S&P 500 after, with official S&P Dow Jones Indices closes via FRED where Yahoo's differ. Prices exclude dividends.
- Nifty 50: Yahoo Finance (^NSEI), daily from 17 Sep 2007.
- Gold: World Bank Pink Sheet, London bullion, monthly: https://www.worldbank.org/en/research/commodity-markets
- Bitcoin: Blockchain.com daily market price from 18 Aug 2010: https://www.blockchain.com/explorer/charts/market-price
- Treasury bonds: a 7.5-duration 10-year Treasury total-return model.
- Planetary positions: Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03, Lahiri sidereal, 1900–2035: https://www.astro.com/swisseph/
- Source code: https://github.com/kpdagrt22/strikehike-monorepo

## About

- [About](https://strikehike.com/about): what the site is and is not.
- [Disclaimer](https://strikehike.com/disclaimer): limits and data sources.
- Built and run by Prakash Kantumutchu (https://thisiskp.in).

## Not claimed

- No forecast, target, signal or investment advice.
- The sky layer is a historical lens, not a cause.
- A geometry match is a similarity in planetary positions, not a prediction.

## How to cite

Cite as: StrikeHike, <page title>, <page URL>, data to <the date shown on that page>.
For example: StrikeHike, Tested, https://strikehike.com/tested, data to the date shown on the claim page.
